description:
Do the MECHANICAL part of porting non-core add-ons to `target_major`: copy every module from
    `source_dir` into `ported_dir`, bump each manifest's version to the target major, strip broken
    view/report XML (so the model + DATA layer installs even when the UI needs a later hand-port),
    and rename `<tree>`->`<list>` (Odoo 18+). This is the `auto` class only - the `assist` fixes
    addon_migrate_assess lists (removed core fields, res.groups category_id, comodel renames,
    Constraint supers, dead xml ids) still need applying by the agent/human, and `manual` modules
    are left for review. After this, point Odoo's addons_path at `ported_dir` and install the
    modules; then re-import the preserved data and verify counts. dry_run (default) shows the exact
    script; confirm=true runs it. Preview-gated.

    target_major >= 20 adds (run on the box that has Odoo 20 installed): `depends` on modules that
    are gone in 20 are mapped (base_vat -> base, ...), then Odoo 20's OWN converters run on the
    ported copy - ir.model.access.csv + ir.rule -> security/ir.access.csv, type="base64" -> "bytes",
    registry.clear_cache -> transaction.invalidate_ormcache, _rec_names_search tuple, t-call. Each
    is dry-run first and refused if it would touch anything outside ported_dir. Without the Odoo 20
    package on the box it converts nothing and says so (ok=false).

    keep_views=True keeps the view/report/template XML and the menus (only the version bump,
    <tree>-><list> and the 20 converters run). Use it for a module whose templates ARE what it does
    (login skin, tracker snippet): stripped, it installs and does nothing. The install is then the
    check - a broken xpath fails it loudly instead of being silently dropped.
name: addon_port_prepare
